services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Trip times must be scheduled so that if you book a 3-4 hour cruise, it doesn’t exceed one normal trip time slot. A 5-6 hour cruise should not exceed 2 normal trip time slots. Please ask for clarification on this if needed. Also, consider your guests, are there any seniors or young children in your group. You may want to choose items that are self-serve and easy to eat. Tall wedding cakes are vulnerable, so consider carefully when planning Everyone who drinks alcohol must be 21 years of age and we do not allow alcohol before we swim. blurb: This cruise is the best one for families with young children or those who want to avoid afternoon heat. Pack your cooler with your favorite drinks and snacks, as we do not sell any onboard. The early morning is also a fantastic time to see wildlife such as birds, turtles, and dolphins. This trip begins with a 20-minute ride to our swim location, where you may also snorkel.
